name: Tori 02 · Parse + save booking
description: Sub-workflow: an LLM (Groq) reads one stored email into strict JSON, then tori.apply_parse() saves booking, slots, clashes, alerts and outbox jobs in ONE Postgres transaction.

parameters.content:
## 02 · Parse + save booking
Input: `raw_id` (from 01, 04 retries or 05 reprocess).

1. Groq LLM (strict JSON schema) → booking JSON
2. `tori.apply_parse()` — one transaction: validate court/hours, upsert booking + slots, clash check with court row locks, alerts, outbox (calendar + WhatsApp)
3. kick **03** so the calendar updates within seconds

Transient LLM errors → email stays `pending_parse`; 04 retries it every minute (max 3 real failures; Groq 429s don't count), then it becomes a "Check Playo email" note.
